defects: Unauthorised surcharge: non-PO delivery and handling line of $640.00 exceeds the $500.00 cap in clause 6, so the contract clause 6.2 pass-through is not permitted
rationale: Line 1 matches the PO and receipt exactly (6 EACH @ $410.00, GR-7718) and tax of $232.50 equals 7.5% of net, so those are clean. The decisive issue is invoice line 2: a non-PO 'Delivery and handling, oversize drums' charge of $640.00. Contract clause 6.2 permits passing through oversize carrier cost, but clause 6 of the policy also requires the charge be $500.00 or less; at $640.00 it fails, making it an unauthorised surcharge -> HOLD_PRICE_VARIANCE with payable $0.00. Single defect, so no clause 11 escalation.
